props.text: Lymphatic drainage massage is a slow, very light massage that follows the body's lymph pathways. Here in Seminyak we give it as manual lymphatic drainage (MLD), in sessions of 1, 1.5 or 2 hours from IDR 300.000, at our spa or at your villa or hotel. It's often chosen after a long flight, when legs or ankles feel heavy or puffy.

props.title: How a Lymphatic Drainage Massage Runs
props.text: A session starts with a short chat about how you feel, any health conditions and the areas you'd like focused on; then your therapist works from the neck and collarbone down to the ankles, always stroking toward the nearest lymph nodes. A longer session adds time, not pressure. You stay covered with a towel or spa wear, and only the area being massaged is uncovered. It shouldn't hurt, so tell your therapist if the pressure feels too firm.
featuresLeft: A short chat about how you feel
featuresRight: Upper legs, then calves and ankles

props.title: After a Lymphatic Drainage Massage
props.text: Drink water and keep the rest of the day easy. Some people feel tired, thirsty or slightly light-headed afterwards, so stand up slowly and rest before you drive or ride a scooter. The lighter feeling is temporary, and how long it lasts differs from guest to guest. A few things that help:

props.subTitle: Frequently Asked Questions
props.title: Questions About Lymphatic Drainage Massage

items.question: How much does a lymphatic drainage massage cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: A lymphatic drainage massage costs IDR 300.000 for 1 hour, IDR 440.000 for 1.5 hours and IDR 580.000 for 2 hours, per person. At your villa or hotel, add IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta.

items.question: Can a lymphatic massage help with swollen legs after travelling?
items.answer: It can leave them feeling lighter and more comfortable. Long flights, road trips and long periods of sitting can cause temporary fluid retention, and lymphatic drainage massage is often chosen for that. If your legs are painful, red or swollen on one side only, see a doctor first.

items.question: Is a lymphatic massage the same as a deep tissue massage?
items.answer: No. Deep tissue massage uses firm pressure on deeper muscle layers. A lymphatic drainage massage uses light, rhythmic strokes that follow the lymph pathways just under the skin.

items.question: What do I wear during a lymphatic drainage massage?
items.answer: You stay covered with a towel or spa wear, and only the area being massaged is uncovered.

items.question: Can I book a lymphatic massage for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability: message us with the time you'd like and we'll confirm the next free slot. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at the spa or at your villa or hotel.

items.question: Can I have a lymphatic massage after liposuction or other surgery?
items.answer: Only once your surgeon has cleared you for it. Tell us the procedure and its date when you book, and we will check with you that the session is right for you.

items.question: Can I combine it with other treatments?
items.answer: Yes. The Lymphatic & Gold Facial pairs 1 hour of each for IDR 525.000 per person (IDR 569.000 booked separately), and many guests add foot reflexology or a body scrub to the same visit.

items.question: Can I have lymphatic drainage on my face?
items.answer: Yes, as part of the 1-hour [Bali Moon Facial](/seminyak/facial/), which includes an argan oil lymphatic facial massage. The lymphatic massage on this page works on the body, from the neck down.

items.question: Will I lose weight with a lymphatic massage?
items.answer: No. A lymphatic massage does not remove fat. Your legs can feel lighter and less puffy afterwards, but that is temporary.
